keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «하나의 꿈이 멈춰 버렸다(문제)» 와 «나누는 것이 둘 다를 행복하게 했다(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (Hana's dreams stopped) and the lesson (sharing made both of them happy). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: A dream thief was stealing Hana's dreams.
Hana drew a bright picture for the thief instead.

opts: A dream thief was stealing them.
She was too sick to sleep.
evs: Every night, Hana dreamed about flying over oceans and talking to whales.
Hana grabbed the jar. "Why are you stealing my dreams?"
"Take this instead, and come back for a new one every week."
On Friday night, Hana pretended to sleep.
why: 하나는 병을 붙잡고 «왜 내 꿈을 훔쳐 가니?» 하고 물었어요. 꿈 도둑이 하나의 꿈을 훔쳐 가고 있었어요.
Hana grabbed the jar and asked, "Why are you stealing my dreams?" A dream thief was taking her dreams.

qs.q: The text says, "Hana pretended to sleep." What did Hana really do?
qs.qko: "Hana pretended to sleep."라고 나와요. 하나는 실제로 무엇을 했나요?
opts: She stayed awake and waited quietly.
She slept very deeply all night.
evs: Sharing made both of them happy.
At midnight, a small shadow climbed through the window with an empty jar.
Then she took out her crayons and drew a bright picture of the sea and the whales.
But one week, her dreams stopped.
why: 한밤중에 그림자가 창문으로 들어오는 것을 하나가 보았어요. 잠든 척하면서 사실은 깨어 있었다는 뜻이에요.
At midnight, Hana saw a shadow climb through the window. So she was really awake, only acting like she was asleep.

qs.q: Why did Hana give the creature a drawing?
opts: The creature lived in a gray world with no colors, so she shared her colors.
The creature asked to buy her crayons.
Hana wanted it to leave and never come back.
evs: "I live in a gray world with no colors. Your dreams are the only beautiful thing I have."
She saw only darkness, and she woke up tired and grumpy.
Then she took out her crayons and drew a bright picture of the sea and the whales.
Every night, Hana dreamed about flying over oceans and talking to whales.
why: 생명체는 색깔이 없는 회색 세상에 살고 있었어요. 그래서 하나는 바다와 고래를 밝은 색으로 그려 주었어요. 두 문장을 이으면 답이 나와요.
The creature lived in a gray world with no colors. So Hana drew a bright picture of the sea and the whales for it.

ends: Hana visits the creature's gray world and paints it with colors.
하나가 생명체의 회색 세상에 가서 색을 칠해 줘요.
The creature brings Hana a dream gift from its world.
생명체가 자기 세상에서 하나에게 꿈 선물을 가져와요.

write.src: “I want to <u>share my crayons</u> because <u>it makes my friends happy</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «하고 싶은 일 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what you want to do and your reason in English.

chips.label: draw

write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «I want to» 뒤에는 동사(share, draw, read)를 바로 쓰고, «because» 뒤에는 «누가 + 무엇을» 을 쓰세요.
write.moreEn: One more step: after «I want to», write a verb (share, draw, read). After «because», write who + what.

img.cover: In a moonlit bedroom, a girl with short black hair and bangs in yellow pajamas with blue stars kneels on her bed and holds out a crayon drawing of a blue sea with jumping whales to a small round gray creature with big shiny eyes and long fuzzy ears, whose ears begin to glow with rainbow colors, while an empty glass jar lies on the blanket.

scenes.1: At midnight in a dark bedroom, a girl with short black hair and bangs in yellow pajamas with blue stars peeks out from under her blanket, while a small round gray creature with big shiny eyes and long fuzzy ears climbs in through the open window carrying an empty glass jar.
scenes.2: In the moonlit bedroom, a girl with short black hair and bangs in yellow pajamas with blue stars holds the empty glass jar with both hands, while a small round gray creature with big shiny eyes and long fuzzy ears sits on the floor and cries big shiny tears.
